segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English. In this podcast we have real conversations in

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: easy English to help you learn. I'm Beth.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: And I'm Neil. Don't forget you can watch a video version of this podcast

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: and read the subtitles to help you understand on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Hi Neil, how are you?

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: I'm very well, Beth. How are you?

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: I'm good. I'm feeling relaxed. Are you?

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: I am feeling relaxed.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Well, that's good because today we are talking about relaxing.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: If you relax, then you do less activity and you are calm and happy.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Sounds great. Shall we start?

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: I think we should.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: So, Neil, what sort of things do you find relaxing?

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Well, I find doing something really different to the thing I was doing before, like work,

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: relaxing.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: So if I have been working sometimes I like to cook to relax or maybe play my guitar or even go for a run do some exercise I find that relaxing

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Yeah.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: I also think that cooking can be relaxing.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: But to be honest, I only really relax in the kitchen if I also have some music on or a podcast.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: And if I'm in the kitchen on my own and then I can just do whatever I want to.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: So Beth, it sounds like listening to music in the kitchen helps you switch off. Now switch off means stop thinking about the thing you were doing before that maybe causes you stress.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Yeah if you switch off you definitely relax And I do find music listening to music relaxing It definitely helps me switch off because whatever I doing whether it cooking or even something boring like doing the washing up or folding laundry if I have music on then I just focus on the music maybe sing along or just listening and that really takes my mind off everything else

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: What do you do to rest Rest means kind of do nothing in order to recover from being busy

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: To rest. I really enjoy having a bath and reading a book in the bath. That really helps me

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: to relax and rest.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: What about you?

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: I'm not very good at resting

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: because I think I get bored and sad.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: So for me to relax,

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: it's better to do something active

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: and then I feel more relaxed

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: and like I've had a rest.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Yeah, sometimes I feel guilty when I rest

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: because I think,

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: oh, I shouldn't be doing this.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: I need to do this, this and this. And I find it a bit hard. But I think relaxing and taking a break

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: is very important because we need it to make ourselves feel better generally, don't we?

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Absolutely.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Okay let recap the language we use during the conversation starting with relax If you relax you do less activity and you are calm and happy

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: And we can also describe an activity as relaxing and that means it makes you feel calm and happy.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: We also heard switch off, which means to stop thinking about stressful things.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: We also heard rest, which means stop doing things so that you can relax.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: For example, when I want to rest, I have a bath and read a book.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: And we heard take your mind off something, which means stop thinking about one thing and start thinking about another.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: For example, I like to watch football. It takes my mind off the stressful day at work.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Why not test what you've learnt with the worksheet over on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: We'll be back next week with another real conversation in Easy English.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Goodbye for now.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Goodbye.
